items.title: WM Q3 deep dive: margin expansion and healthcare integration offset volume headwinds
items.summary: Waste management services provider Waste Management (NYSE:WM) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.3% year on year to $6.85 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $26.38 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.15 per share was 1.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 5 revealing analyst questions from Waste Management’s Q3 earnings call
